source.title: Judge did not call out inspection times, and competitor overinspected
source.content:
A competitor had a judge who misinterpreted a comment by the competitor as them indicating that they were "ready". The competitor immediately called a delegate and was granted an extra solve.

Later, it was found that the judge was not calling out inspection times (8/12 seconds) for the first four solves. The competitor asked for the judge to be replaced for their fifth solve. 

The delegates viewed video footage of the competitor's solves and deemed that the judge indeed did not call out 8/12 seconds. Additionally, the competitor had overinspected (above 15 seconds but below 17 seconds) for the second, third, and fourth solves. 

The delegates and WRC agreed on the following ruling: the competitor was experienced enough and had enough chances to recognize that the judge was not calling out inspection times. The second, third, and fourth solves of the average (which had the overinspection) obtained a +2 penalty.

translation.title: 裁判未提示观察时间，选手观察超时
translation.content:
裁判将选手的一句评论误当成“准备好了”。选手立即叫来代表，并获额外尝试。

后来发现，裁判在前四次还原均未提示 8 秒、12 秒。选手要求第五次更换裁判。

代表观看视频后确认裁判确实未报时；第二、三、四次还原的观察均超过 15 秒但不足 17 秒。

代表和 WRC 一致认定，选手经验足够，也有充分机会察觉裁判未报时。因此，该平均中观察超时的第二、三、四次均加 2 秒。
